title: Ecwid
snippet:
The REST API requires a paid Ecwid plan (Venture or above) — Free plan users can only use the widget embed.

The Ecwid REST API uses Bearer token authentication with your numeric store ID embedded in the base URL. The API provides full access to products, orders, customers, and discount codes. However, the REST API is only available on Ecwid's Venture plan ($19/month) or higher — users on the Free plan who try to use the API Connector will receive 403 Forbidden errors.

- An Ecwid Venture plan ($19/month) or higher if you need REST API access — the Free plan blocks API calls with 403 errors
- Your Ecwid Store ID — the numeric value visible in your Ecwid Control Panel URL (e.g., store12345678 means your store ID is 12345678)
- Your Ecwid API access token — generated from Control Panel → Settings → API (only available on Venture plan or above)

Note: if you need a RapidDev team to review your Ecwid catalog architecture or help with complex filter logic, visit rapidevelopers.com/contact for a free scoping call.

title: Ecwid Pricing 2026
snippet:
Ecwid offers **4 pricing editions**, starting from **$0** to **$105**. Ecwid pricing tiers are designed to support different usage levels and team sizes. Ecwid also offers a **free trial**. Compare the Ecwid pricing table below to figure out the best fit for your needs. Some plans may require you to contact **Lightspeed** for **custom pricing**.
---
Free — $0 / Flat Rate With One-Time Purchase
Venture — $25 / Flat Rate Per Month
Business — $45 / Flat Rate Per Month
Unlimited — $105 / Flat Rate Per Month
Rated 4.7 / 5

Yes. According to G2 data, Ecwid offers a free plan with limited features. Users can upgrade to paid plans for additional capabilities. Visit the seller's official pricing page to compare plan options and features.

Ecwid offers a free plan capped at 10 products with basic store functionality, which G2 reviewers frequently praise as an ideal starting point for testing e-commerce without financial risk. Ecwid's paid plans unlock significantly more capability: the Starter tier ($5.00) allows 5 products with multi-site selling, while the Venture plan ($30.00/month) adds 100 products, discount coupons, social platform syncing, enhanced SEO, and live chat support. Higher tiers like Business ($55.00/month) and Unlimited ($130.00/month) introduce marketplace advertising, wholesale pricing, order editing, and priority support.

title: Ecwid alternatives and the Ecwid API, compared
snippet:
Ecwid’s pricing page lists four paid plans and no free plan: Starter at $5 a month for up to 10 products, Venture at $35 for discount coupons and automated tax, Business at $65 for subscriptions, and Unlimited at $149. Ecwid adds no transaction fee, but your payment provider charges its own, and Ecwid’s API is open only to stores on paid plans. For a US business with a developer, Flint Pay is the alternative with no monthly plan: one API with Stripe processing, products and variants, inventory, coupons and promotions, automatic US sales tax, subscriptions, and hosted checkout, at 3.79% + 35¢ per card payment, plus 0.50% on payments that carry automatic tax and 0.40% on subscription payments.

| What you need | Ecwid plans | Flint |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly price | Starter $5, Venture $35, Business $65, Unlimited $149 a month, or $5, $29, $49, and $119 a month billed annually. No free plan is listed. | No monthly fee. 3.79% + 35¢ per card payment, which covers Stripe's processing fees. |
| Card payments | No Ecwid transaction fee. You connect one of 70+ payment providers, such as Stripe, and pay that provider's rates. | Stripe, on a processing account Flint sets up and runs for you: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH debit, and Affirm.`POST /v1/checkout-sessions` |

| Sales tax | Automated tax calculations from Venture, $35 a month. | Automatic US sales tax computed after discounts and recorded on each line, at 0.50% only on payments that carry tax.`tax_money` |
| Subscriptions | Selling subscriptions from Business, $65 a month. | Subscriptions at 0.40% of subscription payments, with trials, setup fees, retries, and buyer pause and skip.`POST /v1/subscriptions` |
| API access | “Only stores on paid plans can access API,” through a custom app’s access tokens. | The API is the product: every account and every sandbox, with a public OpenAPI spec you can read without a key.`POST /v1/orders` |

- Starter $5, Venture $35, Business $65, Unlimited $149 a month; $5, $29, $49, $119 billed annually; no free plan listed; coupons and automated tax from Venture; subscriptions from Business; product limits; no setup or transaction fees. [Ecwid: Pricing](https://www.ecwid.com/pricing)

Ecwid's pricing page lists no free plan. Its plans start with Starter at $5 a month for up to 10 products. FitSmallBusiness, a third-party reviewer, reports that Ecwid stopped offering the free plan to new users in March 2025 and told remaining free stores they would close on November 20, 2025
